guidance.statement: Positive FY27 growth expected; late-stage single to early-stage double-digit at worst case
guidance.quote: expect FY27 to deliver growth, with exports and global biologicals

guidance.statement: INR 700-800 crore capex for manufacturing, new launches, R&D across pharma and agrochem
guidance.quote: we should have INR 700 to INR 800 crore of capex

guidance.quote: We expect FY27 and thereafter ETR to inch upto 24%

guidance.statement: Pharma to reach INR 500-600 crore revenue for EBITDA positivity within 2+ years
guidance.quote: achieving a INR 500 crore – INR 600 crore top line

guidance.statement: Target $100 million (approx INR 800 crore) revenue in electronic chemicals segment
guidance.quote: looking to target about $100 million in the next 4 to 5 years

guidance.quote: continue to manage and maintain the average gross margin of last year

guidance.quote: we should be in the position that you are looking to achieve

delivered.statement: Delivered ₹67,137 million revenue for FY26 with 3-year CAGR growth
Achieved healthy EBITDA margin of 25% for full year FY26
Gross margin expanded to 58% during Q4 and for the full year
Strong cash balance of INR 34,265 million enabling strategic investments
Pharma business delivered 40% growth for the full year FY26
Commercialized 5 new molecules in AgChem exports; 4 new domestic brand launches
New products now contribute 18% of AgChem Exports portfolio
Effective tax rate of 22% for full year FY26; higher in Q4 due to non-SEZ sales
Achieved 80% capacity utilization for FY26 across manufacturing facilities
Successfully implemented SAP S/4 Hana for operational backbone strengthening

themes: Global agrochemical downcycle with uneven recovery; Middle East conflict disruption
Strategic shift from manufacturer to global innovator via NCE Pioxaniliprole commercialization
Pharma CDMO platform build-out targeting differentiated capabilities and INR 500-600 crore revenue
Biologicals fastest-growing segment (20%+ CAGR); first-ever foliar nematode product launched
New product innovation derisking strategy; 5 AgChem molecules, 4 domestic launches FY26
Cost management and margin defense amid volatile raw materials, pricing, and supply chains
risks: Patent risk on largest CSM product (Pyroxasulfone); faces genericization amid commodity pricing pressure
Capex gestation extended; asset turns dropped 2.5x to 1.5x; INR 2,600 crore capex conversion delayed
Pharma sector investment slowdown; biotech funding constraints limiting CDMO growth trajectory near-term
Channel inventory, lower commodity prices, rainfall disruption impacting domestic agri demand recovery

analyst_pushback.summary: Saurabh Jain: INR 2,600 crore capex not converting; asset turns fell 2.5x to 1.5x. Management: Multi-year ramp-up takes 4-5 years for new molecule capacities to mature.
Tejas Pradhan: New product absolute revenue flat YoY despite rising % mix. Management: Global agriculture challenging; expect improvement as situation stabilizes.
Tejas Pradhan: INR 700 crore still above FY25 levels. Management: Will maintain this range given business model and supply chain volatility management needs.
Vivek Rajamani: EBITDA fell from 27-28% to 22%. Management: Target is to manage margins but difficult to guide specifically given volatility.

tone_evidence: Confident on long-term strategy (NCE, pharma, biologicals) but defensive on near-term challenges (downcycle, capex lag, margin pressure). Repeatedly cites external volatility to avoid specificity.
